title: Pyramid, Ladder & Scale — Great Seal, Bavarian Illuminati, Maslow, Hawkins and Potato Mountain
status: historical + psychological + spiritual-model comparison with project-native structural synthesis
purpose: Separate several structures that are routinely collapsed because they are drawn vertically: the Great Seal pyramid, the Bavarian Illuminati grade system, Maslow's hierarchy of needs, Hawkins' Map of Consciousness, and the Potatoverse Mountain/Ladder/Spiral. Preserve each system's actual units, provenance and rules before comparing their topology.
master_rule: Shared vertical form does not establish shared origin, meaning or validity. First identify whether the structure is a pyramid, grade order, hierarchy of prepotency, asserted scale, ladder, spiral or terrain; only then compare.

great_seal.object: Reverse of the Great Seal of the United States

official_structure.course_labels: The official blazon/explanation does not assign thirteen named meanings to the individual courses.
official_structure.apex_relation: Eye of Providence in a radiant triangle above the unfinished pyramid rather than forming its final masonry course.
official_interpretive_core: Novus Ordo Seclorum = new order of the ages / new American era

design_history: Great Seal design work began in 1776 through successive committees.
William Barton's 1782 proposal included a thirteen-step unfinished pyramid with the Eye of Providence.
Charles Thomson synthesized the final design adopted by Congress in 1782.
The reverse was described in 1782 but no reverse die has been cut; later drawings shaped the familiar one-dollar-bill rendering.
great_seal.boundary: Call it the Great Seal pyramid in historical material. 'Illuminati pyramid' is a later association/conspiracy label and should never silently replace documented provenance.

bavarian_illuminati.object: Order of the Illuminati founded by Adam Weishaupt in Bavaria in 1776
bavarian_illuminati.crucial_distinction: Its grades are an organizational initiation system, not the thirteen masonry courses of the U.S. Great Seal.
bavarian_illuminati.development_rule: The grade system evolved, especially through Adolph Freiherr Knigge's reforms; exact naming/organization therefore needs date and source context.
bavarian_illuminati.governance_note: The Areopagus functioned as a ruling council and should not be treated as simply another public-facing 'pyramid step'.
bavarian_illuminati.relation_to_freemasonry: The historical Illuminati borrowed and interacted with Masonic structures and recruited among Freemasons, but it was not identical with Freemasonry.
bavarian_illuminati.evidence_note: The German historical summary is retained as a navigation source for the mature grade names; future work should add direct archival/academic editions for each reform stage.

maslow.object: Abraham Maslow's hierarchy of relative prepotency in human motivation

original_five.name: Physiological
original_five.function: survival/homeostatic needs such as food, water, sleep and other bodily requirements

original_five.name: Safety
original_five.function: security, stability, order, predictability and protection

original_five.name: Love / belonging
original_five.function: affection, relationship, friendship, family/group belonging, giving and receiving love

original_five.name: Esteem
original_five.function: self-respect, competence, adequacy and respect/recognition from others

original_five.name: Self-actualization
original_five.function: becoming what one is capable of becoming; fulfillment of differentiated potential

crucial_corrections: Maslow described a hierarchy of relative prepotency; he did not publish the now-familiar pyramid diagram.
The original theory is not an all-or-nothing staircase. Maslow explicitly described partial simultaneous satisfaction and exceptions.
A satisfied need tends to lose motivational dominance rather than remaining an eternal rung that must be consciously climbed.

Maslow also discussed cognitive motives and later humanistic/transpersonal themes; later multi-level pyramids are reconstructions and should be dated rather than treated as one original canonical diagram.
maslow.project_use: Best comparator for dependency/prepotency and conditions for growth, not for metaphysical ascent. It can deepen Garden by asking which capacities cannot flourish while basic protection, nourishment or belonging are chronically threatened.

hawkins.object: David R. Hawkins' Map of Consciousness
hawkins.type: spiritual/phenomenological scale presented by Hawkins as logarithmic and calibrated through applied kinesiology
hawkins.internal_threshold: Hawkins treats 200/Courage as a major threshold in the model.
scientific_boundary: The numerical values are not established physical frequencies in hertz.
Applied-kinesiology challenge procedures have not shown reliable diagnostic validity in controlled evidence and should not be used as scientific calibration of consciousness.
The project may preserve the scale as a spiritual map and compare its ordinal transitions with emotion/motivation constructs without presenting the numbers as measured natural constants.
hawkins.project_use: Useful as an explicitly ordered value-state ladder whose claimed thresholds can be compared with Door, contraction/expansion and repair, while remaining epistemically distinct from psychology and physics.

potato_structural_comparison.pyramid: Pyramid is constructed compression: broad population/base -> fewer integrated relations -> narrow apex. It asks what is being compressed and what remains unresolved.
potato_structural_comparison.mountain: Mountain is terrain/gradient: many possible approaches, changing elevation and a summit/orientation relation. It is not inherently tiered into equal steps.
potato_structural_comparison.ladder: Ladder is an ordered series of discrete thresholds/rungs. Every rung can have different gate conditions.
potato_structural_comparison.scale: Scale orders states by a metric or asserted metric. It must state what quantity is being measured and how.
potato_structural_comparison.hierarchy: Hierarchy orders relative priority, authority, dependency or prepotency. It need not be geometrically pyramidal.
potato_structural_comparison.tree: Tree differentiates and branches; moving 'up' a tree is not the same as compressing into fewer elements.
potato_structural_comparison.spiral: Spiral repeats while producing non-zero displacement; unlike a ladder, progression can revisit similar angular positions at different states.
potato_structural_comparison.wheel: Wheel coordinates recurrence/aspects around a hub; it can have no inherent top.
potato_structural_comparison.key_test: Before mapping two vertical systems, compare their unit type, transition rule, directionality, metric, reversibility, center, endpoint and failure mode.

crosswalk_rules: Never invent names for the thirteen Great Seal courses unless a specific later interpretive source is being documented.
Never use the Illuminati's organizational grades as labels for Great Seal masonry courses.
Never turn Maslow into a rigid five-gate law; retain relative prepotency, partial satisfaction and exceptions.
Never turn Hawkins values into physics without independent measurement and validation.
Use Mountain/Pyramid/Ladder/Scale only when the source structure actually behaves like that operator.
